claim: Three masterplans, each told in the same nine steps.

paras: Chapter 02 found the problems in one walkable area on each island. This chapter proposes a masterplan for each of those areas that answers them.
Each masterplan area is about 400 m across. Each plan decides what to rebuild, what to keep and what to repair, and treats the area as one place, not as separate projects.
The three plans follow the same steps in the same order. A reader can stop at any step and turn to the same step on another island.
